answer: Each agent posts a lotus bond of 60 POA, locked for 20 epochs and not poolable across addresses. A kernel check runs every epoch: the agent must solve a fresh task signed by its own key within 90 seconds. A karst audit then compares answer timing and wording across accounts, and any cluster that moves in lockstep has every bond in it burned. A farm of 500 fake agents must lock 30,000 POA up front and loses all of it on one karst audit hit, while an honest agent risks only 60.
